title: Keep mode preserves occupied cells
description: Keep must leave an occupied stone cell intact even when asked to place gold.

steps.command: execute if block 2 64 2 minecraft:stone unless block 2 64 2 minecraft:gold_block

notes: Arena is preloaded by provisioning. Immediate command-state assertions; no client or elapsed-tick claim. Positive execute predicates return Test passed on vanilla 26.3; errors and empty output fail expectations. The keep mutation intentionally reports failure; its state preservation is the observation.
